Map now shows clusters, not individual pincodes: nearby eligible pincodes (within each other's 30-min-drive-proxy radius) are grouped into one cluster marker, so the map isn't 1,353 dots deep. The table below still lists every individual pincode for detail work.

Color / Zone Reference:
High — top third of clusters, by aggregate cluster score. Strongest candidate zones — prioritize these first.
Medium — middle third. Worth a second look, not a first move.
Low — bottom third. Lower priority given everything else on the list.
Marker size reflects grade tier only, not sales volume — a small High-grade cluster and a small Low-grade cluster look different by color, not by size inflation from revenue.

Adding a new parameter later:
This panel is generated from a single list in the code (FACTORS). To add a new ranking parameter (e.g. competitor density, footfall estimate): add one entry — key, label, description, starting weight — and make sure every pincode has a matching 0–100 percentile score field. A new slider appears automatically here, and the 100% cap rule applies to it the same way. No other rebuild needed.
Built from Shopify order export · shipping pincode joined to India Post office directory (geocoding QA'd & corrected) · phone-based customer dedup · cluster sales = density-adaptive radius proxy for 30-min drive
